Danish juror ranked in reverse; official result stood (DK jury UA 12, AU 10, GE 0). Also https://eurovisionary.com/danish-jury-votes-published. Excluded from pair analysis (design v2.1, red-team #12): the reversed juror distorts the whole DK jury ballot under 2016 average-rank aggregation; S3a re-includes it.
Romania expelled (TVR debts). Structural missing, not 0.
Russia withdrew. Absent as voter and receiver: missing, not 0.

Jury aggregation was the plain average rank in 2016-17 and exponential weighting from 2018 (see jury_method column). Sensitivity: jury analyses without 2016-17, or a year fixed effect. Also https://escxtra.com/2018/04/28/the-jury-voting-change-explained/

Belarus jury dismissed; EBU substitute aggregate (data holds the corrected values). Not a Belarusian jury: excluded from pair analyses; still counts in receiver totals. combined row excluded because it contains the substitute jury ballot.
Ukraine withdrew. Missing, not 0.
FYR Macedonia -> North Macedonia (2019). Code MK unchanged; join on code, never on name.

Contest cancelled (COVID-19). All three rounds have performances: null, so there are no rows; listed so the gap is explicit. https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/eurovision-2020-coronavirus-cancellation-969046/
Belarus disqualified 2021, absent since. Missing, not 0.
Russia excluded from 2022. Missing, not 0.

Six juries removed for irregular SF2 voting patterns; replaced by substitute aggregates in SF2 and final (identical-ballot signature confirmed by the data audit). Also https://escxtra.com/2022/05/19/ebu-reveals-eurovision-2022-irregular-voting-patterns/
Same event as A12a: televote and combined rows of these voters are dropped in the sensitivity run (data audit #12). SM televote is excluded anyway (A13a).

San Marino has no real televote (shares Italy's phone network, below threshold): the EBU substitutes a composite. SM as a televote voter is excluded from pair analyses; SM as receiver is fine. Also https://escinsight.com/2016/12/05/san-marino-televote-eurovision-2016/ (2023+ method not confirmed).
Derived from A13a: SM's combined ballot contains the synthetic televote. (The audit lists the event as public (+total); handling for total not stated separately, so the stricter one is applied.)

WLD = Rest of the World online televote (from 2023): not a country, absent from countries.json, voter_is_country=False. Excluded from pair analyses; still counts in receiver totals. https://www.ebu.ch/news/2022/11/voting-changes-announced-for-eurovision-song-contest-2023

Semi-finals 2023-25 report only `total`, which is the televote (+WLD). Mapped to vote_type=televote, vote_type_source=total. No jury counterpart: exclude these rounds from jury-vs-televote (RQ3) contrasts.
GB hosted on behalf of UA (contest.json intendedCountry=UA). No vote anomaly; 'host' differs from venue in 2023.
Czech Republic -> Czechia branding (2023). Code CZ unchanged.
BG, ME, MK withdrew in 2023 (data-verified; reasons not web-verified). ME returned 2025; BG and MK also absent in 2025. Missing, not 0.
NL entry disqualified after SF2 but NL retained its vote (NL jury gave CH 12). NL as voter kept; dropped in sensitivity run. NL has no receiver rows in the 2024 final: missing, not 0.

semifinal2.json lists NL in `disqualifieds`: NL qualified (2nd, 182 points) but did not perform in the final. Its SF2 points are genuine; flag for selection-on-qualification analyses. https://www.dutchnews.nl/2024/05/disqualified-dutch-eurovision-entry-was-second-in-semi-final/
Norwegian juror said he withheld points from IL; the EBU accepted NRK's notarised result (NO jury gave IL 8).
Broadcasters (ES, BE, FI, IS) asked for audits; the EBU found no irregularity and used no substitutes. Valid data; discuss in RQ3 interpretation (campaigns, diaspora).
RO absent 2024-25 (data). Missing, not 0.
MD absent 2025 (data). Missing, not 0.

New ruleset (juries back in semis, 7-member juries incl. 18-25-year-olds, televote cap 10). Outside the study window; the course fork ends at 2025. Only for an optional out-of-sample check (upstream EurovisionAPI/dataset).
Boycott by ES, NL, IE, SI, IS; BG, MD, RO returned; 35 countries; only 4 Big-Five auto-qualifiers. Handled as A23.
Four juries had 6 instead of 7 members; valid per the EBU.

Australia participates by invitation; must qualify since 2016 and votes only in its own semi + final. Region = Australia and New Zealand, no neighbours: exclude from border tests or code as its own region.
Big Five + host vote in one assigned semi without performing (see voter_performs_in_round). Semi observations exist only for receivers in the voter's semi.
